app.name: Jantrik School
app.tagline: Running a school, madrasa or coaching centre, made simple

errors.invalidCredentials: The phone number, code or password is not correct.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to see this.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your mobile number to continue
login.phoneHint: Bangla or English digits are fine
login.resendIn: You can resend the code in {seconds} seconds
login.brandHeadline: Running a school, madrasa or coaching centre, made simple
login.brandText: Attendance, fees, exam results and guardian SMS, all in one place.
login.pointPrivate: Your institute's data stays with your institute
login.help: Trouble signing in? Contact your institute's office.

selectInstitute.title: Choose an institute
selectInstitute.subtitle: You belong to more than one institute. Which one do you want to work in?
selectInstitute.none: You don't have access to any active institute.

dashboard.subtitle: Today at {institute}, at a glance.
dashboard.presentTodayHint: Shows here once you start taking attendance
dashboard.feesThisMonthHint: Shows here once you start collecting fees
dashboard.upcomingExamHint: Shows here once you schedule an exam
dashboard.collectFeeText: Take a payment, give a receipt
dashboard.checklistText: Finish these steps and your institute is fully set up.
dashboard.stepInstituteText: Your institute is on Jantrik School.
dashboard.stepYearText: Enter the start and end dates of the current year.
dashboard.stepStudentsText: Name, roll and the guardian's mobile number.
dashboard.stepAttendanceText: Guardians get an SMS right away when a child is absent.
dashboard.stepSmsText: Guardians get an SMS when a student is absent.
dashboard.heldText: Today's SMS limit ({cap}) has been reached. If they are not sent today, they will not go out after midnight.
dashboard.heldConfirmTitle: {n, plural, one {Send {count} message now?} other {Send {count} messages now?}}
dashboard.heldConfirmSegmentsValue: {n, plural, one {{segments} SMS segment} other {{segments} SMS segments}}
dashboard.heldConfirmBody: They go out over the daily limit. Each one is checked again first: if the student is no longer absent, no SMS is sent.
dashboard.heldDoneCancelled: Sending {queued} SMS. {cancelled} skipped because the student is now present.
dashboard.heldFailed: The SMS could not be sent. Try again.

students.title: {student} list
students.search: Search by name, ID or phone
students.name: Name
students.emptyHint: Try a different search or filter.
students.emptyAllHint: Once you add {student}s, the list appears here.

comingSoon.text: This section is being built. You'll be able to work here soon.

tenantChanged.title: Institute changed
tenantChanged.body: The institute was changed to {name} in another tab. To avoid editing the wrong institute's data, this page will reload.

notAvailable.title: Not available
notAvailable.text: This section is not enabled for your institute, or you don't have permission.

guardian.subtitle: Your children at {institute}.
guardian.comingSoon: Fees and exam results will appear here soon.
guardian.none: No students are linked to your mobile number yet.
guardian.noneHint: Ask the institute office to add your mobile number to your child's details.

attendance.noSections: You haven't been given any {section} to take attendance for yet.
attendance.noSectionsHint: Ask the institute admin to add you to your {section}.
attendance.unsentTitle: Attendance on this phone, not sent yet
attendance.tapHint: Tap a name to change it
attendance.syncLocal: Kept on this phone, not sent yet
attendance.syncRetrying: Couldn't send. Trying again in {seconds} s
attendance.offlineCopy: No connection. Showing the list kept on this phone; it will be sent when you're back online.
attendance.unavailable: The attendance list can't be loaded.
attendance.confirmBody: {count} of {total} students are marked absent. Submit if that is right.
attendance.rosterChanged: The student list changed: {added} new (marked present), {removed} removed. Check and submit again.
attendance.blockedEDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: It's too late to change this day. Ask the institute admin if it needs a fix.
attendance.blockedFUTURE_DATE: Attendance can't be taken for a future day.
attendance.errorGeneric: Couldn't submit ({code}). The list is kept on this phone.

connection.title: Can't reach the server
connection.body: The internet looks weak. You don't need to do anything; we keep trying.
connection.drafts: {count} attendance lists on this phone are waiting to be sent. They will go as soon as the connection is back.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: An error stopped this page from showing. Try again, or reload the page. Attendance kept on this phone is not lost.

reports.csvFailed: The CSV could not be downloaded.
reports.daysTaken: Attendance taken on {count} days this month
reports.noDays: No attendance taken this month yet.
reports.calendarNone: No attendance taken this month yet.

attendanceSettings.title: Attendance settings
attendanceSettings.adminOnly: Only the owner or an admin can change the settings.
attendanceSettings.editWindow: How many days back teachers can change attendance
attendanceSettings.editWindowHint: 0 means today only. Admins can change any day.
attendanceSettings.leaveRuleHint: When off, leave days are left out of the present rate.
attendanceSettings.smsEnabled: Send guardians an SMS when a student is absent
attendanceSettings.smsHint: One per student per day, for today's attendance only, to the primary guardian.
attendanceSettings.templateVars: These words are filled in for you:
attendanceSettings.unicodeNote: Bangla text fits 70 characters in one SMS; longer text costs one SMS per 67.
attendanceSettings.tooLong: This text is longer than 3 SMS. Make it shorter.
attendanceSettings.delayHint: If the teacher corrects a mistake in this time, no SMS is sent.
attendanceSettings.capHint: Over the limit, the rest are held back; you can send them from the dashboard.
attendanceSettings.holidaysHint: No attendance is taken on these days.
attendanceSettings.noHolidays: No holidays added for this year.

setup.title: Institute setup
setup.inUseHint: In use, so it can't be deleted; deactivate it
setup.name: Name
setup.sectionNameHint: e.g. A, B or Morning batch
setup.yearsHint: One {year} is always current; attendance, admissions and lists use it.
setup.copySections: Copy every {section} of {name} into the new year
setup.copySectionsHint: Only the structure is copied, not the students.
setup.makeCurrentBody: Attendance, admissions and lists will then use this {year}.
setup.classesHint: Each {section} belongs to one academic year. Things in use can't be deleted, only deactivated.
setup.shiftsHint: Shifts are optional; a {section} can have one.
setup.groupsHint: Science, Business Studies, Humanities and so on.
setup.groupUsage: {ns, plural, one {{subjects} subject} other {{subjects} subjects}}, {nst, plural, one {{students} student} other {{students} students}}
setup.labelsHint: The words your institute uses (e.g. Batch instead of Section) are shown everywhere in the app.
setup.labelsRequired: Write every name in both Bangla and English.
setup.errorInUse: It is in use, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
setup.errorInactive: It is deactivated; activate it first.
setup.errorCapacity: More students than that are already enrolled.
setup.errorDuplicate: This name or code already exists.
setup.errorCheckForm: Fix the fields marked in red.
setup.errorReference: It is linked to something else, or what you picked no longer exists. Reload the page.
setup.studentCodeHint: How IDs are made for new admissions. Existing IDs stay the same.

staff.title: Staff
staff.hint: Who works here and in which roles. Add someone by their mobile number.
staff.rolesHint: A person can have several roles.
staff.nameBnHint: Optional; shown in the Bangla app for a new person
staff.otpNote: No SMS is sent. They can log in with OTP on this number.
staff.sectionsHint: The sections of the current academic year they teach and take attendance for.
staff.deactivateBody: They lose access to this institute at once. Nothing is deleted; you can activate them again later.
staff.activateBody: They can log in again with their previous roles.
staff.errorAlreadyStaff: The person with this number is already on the staff list.
staff.errorLastOwner: The institute must keep at least one active owner.
staff.errorSelf: You cannot change your own roles or status.
staff.errorNotTeaching: Only active teachers or admins can be given sections.
staff.errorSections: Some sections were not found or are inactive. Reload the page.
staff.errorNoYear: There is no current academic year. Make one current in institute setup first.
staff.errorOwnerOnly: Only an owner can make changes involving owners.
staff.errorCheckForm: Fix the fields marked in red.

admission.enrolmentHint: The academic year, class and section to enrol into.
admission.boardHint: Needed for JSC/SSC registration; can be filled in later.
admission.guardiansHint: The primary guardian gets attendance SMS. Each can log in to the app with OTP on their number; no SMS is sent now.
admission.rollHint: Leave empty to give it later
admission.studentCodeHint: Leave empty to generate one, e.g. {example}
admission.adminOnly: Only an owner or admin can admit students.
admission.errorName: Write a name in Bangla or English
admission.errorBirthReg: A birth registration number has 17 digits
admission.errorBirthRegTaken: Another student has this birth registration number
admission.errorRollTaken: This roll is already taken in the section
admission.errorSectionFull: This section has no seats left
admission.errorRollNeedsSection: Choose a section to give a roll
admission.errorCheckForm: Fix the fields marked in red.

profile.transferHint: Another section of the same year and class. The roll must be free there.
profile.deactivateBody: They leave the lists and attendance registers; their roll can be given to someone else. Nothing is deleted.
profile.canLogIn: Can log in to the app
profile.primaryHint: The primary guardian gets attendance SMS.
profile.errorPrimaryRequired: Make someone else the primary guardian first.
profile.errorGuardianRequired: A student needs at least one guardian.
profile.errorNotEnrolled: Not enrolled in the current year.
profile.errorCheckForm: Fix the fields marked in red.
